items.title: MECH-321 scale-resolved rollout boundary diagnostic (spike 5b) on the 816 harness
items.note: DIAGNOSTIC, claim_ids=[] (bears on MECH-321 / MECH-288 / ARC-070; weights nothing). Executes section 5b of mech321_decomposition_scale_scoping_spike_2026-07-27 on the EXISTING 816 harness (816d's dose-escalated harshened env, verbatim) -- no new env work. QUESTION: do MECH-288's fast (PE/z-score over z_world+z_self) and slow (BOCPD over z_goal) scales fire at DISSOCIABLE rollout positions once the slow scale is given its stream? This is a THIRD campaign axis -- trigger COMPOSITION -- attacking the ALWAYS-FIRES end (816d decomp_fired_frac_arm1=1.0) that neither open axis (816's trigger sensitivity, 816c's trigger validity) addresses; MECH-321's declared PRIMARY V_s trigger has never fired campaign-wide (816c vs_trigger_fires_total=0). SUBSTRATE ALREADY LANDED, not rebuilt: ree-v3 9a6e7f3976 (use_decomposition_scale_resolved_probe, default OFF; per-scale get_state counters). ARMS: both run MECH-321; manipulation is the probe flag alone. ARM_PROBE_OFF is the attribution control and is NOT optional -- the flag is not a pure diagnostic (with z_goal present the slow scale can newly reach boundary.fired and change decisions). PASS/FAIL: the load-bearing criterion is C_DECIDABLE (did the instrument return a reading), NOT 'did slow fire' -- so all THREE pre-registered spike readings (dissociable / slow-never-fires / slow-only-with-fast) score as informative results and only a not-ready instrument FAILs. POSITION READOUT is driver-side (wraps _evaluate_decomposition_ticks and reads per-scale counter deltas per tick); no substrate increment, and instrumentation coverage is a gated precondition. AUTHORING FOUND 3 LAYERS OF SILENT INERTNESS the readiness gate refused twice before queuing: (a) from_dims z_goal_enabled defaults False -> goal_state None; (b) from_dims benefit_threshold=0.1 is unreachable on this env dose (measured 2941 random-policy steps: max benefit_exposure 0.1018, >0.1 on 0.03% of steps) -> now 0.05, the substrate's own enable_goal_stream default (config.py:5095), seeding on 8.1% of steps; (c) ROOT CAUSE -- the 816 harness never calls agent.update_z_goal(), the sole z_goal write hook, so z_goal was the zero vector at ANY threshold. Now called once per step in BOTH arms, kwargs-only per _harness.py StepHarness invariant 2 (the EXQ-471/475/483 cohort bug). Declared side effect: update_z_goal is also the SD-024 benefit-attractor producer, so it un-zeroes the SD-025 curiosity bonus -- identical in both arms (not a confound) but ARM_PROBE_OFF is therefore NOT bit-identical to 816d ARM_1 and must not be cited as a reproduction of it. KNOWN ASYMMETRY BOUNDED NOT ASSUMED AWAY: the flag covers the pre-commitment sweep only; agent.py's mid-execution hook keeps its own {z_world,z_self} signature, so midexec ticks advance fast but never slow. Manifest records naive AND precommit-corrected slow fractions plus midexec_dilution_frac. Extending the midexec hook is a separate /implement-substrate increment, named not done. GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout decomp_n_boundary_fires_slow / per-scale rollout position is absent from the entire corpus (reanalysis_query over 726 manifests: 0 carry it; the counters landed 2026-07-27) -> not recoverable, must run. Re-derive brake N/A (claim_ids empty; new axis, not a lettered re-pose). Smoke PASS (gate green, decidable=True, zgoal present_frac 0.33 norm_std 0.0097, coverage 1.0, control arm slow-silent).

items.title: INV-091: cross-stream similarity BAND falsifier, remaining 5 ablations (event broadcasts / mode conditioning / residue feedback / randomised rates / harm-stream collapse)
items.note: Complements V3-EXQ-827/827a (INV-091 cross-stream similarity BAND falsifier), which already exercised landmark removal (DECOUPLE) and forced lockstep (LOCKSTEP) -- both self-routed substrate_not_ready_requeue. This run exercises the remaining FIVE of the claim's seven named ablations on the SAME shared-warmed-substrate-per-seed design and infra (stream_recorder, trace_store, q081_profile, q081_surrogate, arm_fingerprint -- no infra rebuilt): BROADCAST_OFF (toggles agent.hippocampal.config.use_invalidation_trigger=False for the eval window -- MECH-287 ONLY, distinct from 827/827a's landmark-removal arm which hits MECH-269/287/288 together; boundary events and use_anchor_sets untouched), MODE_DECORRELATED (patches agent.salience.tick to feed it independent per-tick noise instead of the real dacc_bundle/drive_level, NOT use_salience_coordinator=False which would null the operating_mode stream outright), RESIDUE_OFF (forces hypothesis_tag=True on every agent.update_residue call, reusing MECH-094's own accumulation-block mechanism), RATE_RANDOMIZED (resamples agent.clock.e2_steps_per_tick / _e3_base_steps fresh every episode from pre-registered ranges (1,6)/(3,18), breaking the fixed 1:3:10 phase relationship without forcing synchrony either extreme), HARM_COLLAPSE (patches agent.latent_stack.encode to overwrite the returned LatentState's z_harm_a with a truncated slice of that SAME call's z_harm -- adds a 5th similarity pair (z_harm, z_harm_a) to the statistic specifically for this arm; its movement on that ONE pair is BY CONSTRUCTION per design, analogous to how 827a's lockstep is constructed to move via forced tick synchrony -- overall C1/C2 still require the pooled 5-pair mean and the other 4 (unrelated) pairs to move for real). C1/C2 REDESIGNED for 6 arms (N-arm generalisation of 827/827a's bipolar 3-arm shape, since these 5 ablations do not admit a clean pre-registered direction the way landmark-removal/lockstep did): C1 = at least one ablation moves mean similarity away from intact by >= SIMILARITY_MOVE_FLOOR (claim's own literal non-degeneracy wording, applied across the full 6-arm set rather than one pre-chosen pair). C2 = the empirical peak-composite arm is INTERIOR (neither the empirical similarity min nor max across all 6 arms) and beats both empirical extremes by >= COMPOSITE_MARGIN (generalises 'intact beats both extremes' to an arbitrary similarity ranking; a secondary non-load-bearing diagnostic still reports whether intact specifically beats both extremes for continuity with 827/827a). Thresholds unchanged from 827/827a (SIMILARITY_MOVE_FLOOR=0.02, COMPOSITE_MARGIN=0.15) -- properties of the DVs, not of which manipulations produced them. DV-SYMMETRY: none of the 5 manipulations is a broadcast-scalar/monotone-rescaling symmetry invariant by construction; full per-arm declaration in the script's module docstring, including the HARM_COLLAPSE construction-effect caveat above. RE-DERIVE BRAKE: INV-091 has exactly 1 prior autopsy (failure_autopsy_batch-822a-826-817a-827_2026-07-26), below the >=2 threshold and targeting an instrument defect (827's confounded lockstep construction) that would not count toward the brake even at a higher tally; this run tests 5 DIFFERENT manipulations 827/827a never touched, so it is not a re-derive of that autopsy's target regardless. GOV-REUSE-1: reanalysis_query.py --claim INV-091 (2026-07-27) returns only V3-EXQ-827/827a (different substrate_hash from each other), neither carrying any of these 5 ablations or the (z_harm, z_harm_a) pair -- not recoverable, first run. Substrate readiness: all 5 mechanisms (SD-032a salience coordinator, MECH-094 residue tagging, SD-006 multi-rate clock, SD-010/SD-011 harm streams, MECH-287 invalidation trigger) are already live/IMPLEMENTED substrate used across many prior experiments incl. 827/827a themselves -- no substrate gap. Smoke PASS (--dry-run, 2 warmup/2 eval eps/20 steps): all 6 arms x 3 seeds ran end-to-end with no crashes; toy-scale run happened to clear both criteria (PASS, not scientifically meaningful at this scale, mirrors the expectation that dry-run outcomes are structural checks only). validate_experiments.py --strict: OK, 0 warnings. validate_recording.py --strict on the dry-run manifest: OK, always-core complete. A synthesis of INV-091's evidence must read this manifest ALONGSIDE V3-EXQ-827a's, not in isolation -- together they span all 7 named ablations across two runs.

items.title: MECH-466: event-relative vs clock-relative cross-stream alignment (Q-081 Outcome E)
items.note: FIRST MECH-466 run; direct sibling of V3-EXQ-824 (Q-081 Outcome A/B), which EXPLICITLY DEFERRED this Outcome E ('event-relative beats clock-relative'). MEASUREMENT-ONLY diagnostic, single substrate per seed, no manipulation arm -- the falsifier's two 'arms' are two INDEXINGS of one recorded trace. Computes the SAME multivariate RV(z_world, operating_mode) used by 824, TWICE: RV_event (coarse-grid samples pooled in +/-3-tick windows around waking landmark onsets = union of MECH-288 boundary pulses + beta commitment-gate rising edges + salience mode_switch_trigger) vs RV_clock (matched-count windows around clock-arbitrary coarse-grid ticks disjoint from events). PASS if mean(RV_event-RV_clock) clears the effect-size floor (K=1.5*SD(delta) or abs 0.03). SECONDARY circular-shift surrogate (199) tests event-locking specifically. SUBSTRATE READINESS (my call, headless): READY. q081_profile enables use_event_segmenter+use_salience_coordinator (already exercised by 824/824a/827). 824's landed manifest at THIS config recorded 1799 steps/seed, admissible RV, and boundary pulses firing non-degenerately (per-seed 4..200 boundaries, rate ~0.002..0.11, mean ~0.039 -- inside the claim-mandated non-degeneracy band). Union event set (adds beta + mode switches) is never starved. So this yields a real PASS/FAIL, not a vacuous ceiling re-derivation. NON-DEGENERACY GUARD (claim-mandated): boundary rate band [0.001,0.60]; a pinned segmenter self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue. WAKING scope only (use_sleep_loop=False); offline/sleep-phase transitions (5th landmark class) deferred to a lettered follow-up, mirroring 824. GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout = event-minus-clock RV delta; absent from the corpus (824 deferred Outcome E, records only the landmark-ablation delta) -> not recoverable, must run. RE-DERIVE BRAKE: MECH-466 has 0 prior autopsies -> not braked. Single claim -> no per-claim direction. Smoke: --dry-run PASS (structural: progress patterns ep N/M + verdict + Seed/Condition present, sentinel written, no manifest at dry-run; toy scale self-routes substrate_not_ready as expected). validate_experiments --strict: OK, 0 warnings.
